name: toast
title: Toast
description: HBD imperative toast/snackbar system ported from the hbd-toast web component. A <ToastProvider> renders the singleton portal region (role=region, aria-label=Notifications, aria-live=polite flipped to assertive for one macrotask on error toasts, aria-relevant=additions) at the viewport edge; a useToast() hook AND a standalone toast() callable (plus toast.info/success/warning/error/show/setPosition) drive a shared module-level store so notifications can be fired without React context. Reproduces the WC 1:1: show({ message, title, variant, duration, action, dismissible }); variants info(default)/success/warning/error with per-variant role (error->alert, else status); auto-dismiss timer (default 5000ms = --hbd-duration-linger) with hover-pause + focus-pause + focus-out-resume and a countdown progress bar whose animation-duration matches and pauses with the timer; prefers-reduced-motion AND Infinity duration disable the timer + drop the progress bar (SC 2.2.1); MAX_STACK=3 active cap with an overflow queue that dequeues on dismiss; enter/leave lifecycle via .is-entering/.is-leaving where the leave animationend fires onDismiss({variant}) (the WC's hbd:dismiss) then removes the toast; setPosition(top-right default | top-center | bottom-right | bottom-center | bottom-left) re-classes the container to swap the directional slide keyframe. The de-shadowed toast.css carries every --hbd-* token and ALL NINE @keyframes verbatim; the inline animation-duration is the documented per-instance value-driven style exception.
